content:
erin_cs: FYI renewal for Nimbus (acct) - they want split billing (Nimbus US / Nimbus EU). Procurement prefers PO for the subscription, but they'll allow CC for the onboarding deposit if we require it. EU procurement also asks for a witnessing clause on the SOW. Can we support split invoices + e-witness and a CC deposit?

sam_sales: Good opportunity. Buyer said PO ETA is ~3 business days. They confirmed e-witness acceptable as long as the audit trail includes signer email. CC for deposit is fine to start provisioning. They want a short escrow-style holdback of 5% until completion of migration.

maya_fin: Finance will accept a card auth for the deposit and then finalize invoicing once PO is uploaded. Conditions: PO must be received within 5 business days or we refund the deposit. Please provide vendor codes and tax IDs for both entities. Invoice metadata to include: `po: TBD`, `billing_split: US:80, EU:20`, `deposit_method: card_auth`, `escrow_pct: 5`.

ben_legal: Draft clause for addendum: "For the EU legal entity, an electronic witness (name and email logged in the signing record) shall satisfy witnessing requirements for this Agreement. Escrow holdback of 5% will be released upon Customer Success sign-off of migration completion." I'll attach as a two-line addendum.

(docusign-bot): Template found: "Renewal-Split-Billing-Escrow". Can create envelope with e-witness field, split-invoice tags, and conditional escrow checkbox. Reply `create envelope` to proceed.

erin_cs: Proceeding with `create envelope` now. Plan: send for signature, charge card auth after signing, wait for PO, then finalize invoice. I'll include procurement email on the envelope for audit.

docusign-bot: Envelope created: https://docusign.example/envelope/0xac-nimbus-split-escrow. Routing: 1) Nimbus EU signer (e-witness) 2) Nimbus US signer 3) Procurement CC 4) Finance ack.

erin_cs: Sent to buyer. Next: monitor signature + card auth, chase PO if not received in 3 days. Will update here. :white_check_mark:
